files.purpose: ThreadRuntime.swift holds the live, main-actor engine behind one chat thread: the @Observable ThreadRuntime class owns the thread's timeline rows, its TurnRecord list, the provider session (CLI or API) with its start, resume, warm-up and restart rules, the coalesced streaming of message/reasoning/tool/plan deltas, approvals and questions, the follow-up queue with drag bundling, git start/end checkpoints plus per-command working-tree snapshots that attribute shell-made edits, revert/resend with optional file restore, and debounced persistence of the ThreadDocument. It also runs the lead side of Hydra: parsing delegation blocks while they stream (now through a persistent HydraDelegationStreamParser and a HydraDelegationBudget), pacing Droppy-run heads through a waiting queue under the pair's cap, batching head reports into one turn, native-head event rehearsal, and (new in 1.6.2) per-turn token spend recording and a live set of paths the current turn has touched. The file additionally defines the small value/view-model types the composer and timeline share: TimelineEntry, ReplyQuote (with peel), DraftCommand, ComposerDraft (with outgoingText), PromptEdit and RuntimePhase, plus a private TimelineItem.Content.appendStreamed extension and a rehearsal extension used for website captures and native head timelines.

feature_notes: B1->B2: (1) New @ObservationIgnored pendingNativeSpend: [String: [TokenSpend]] and private recordTokenSpend(_:) which merges a spend into the turn's tokenSpends by (provider, model, agentID), adds to hydraTokens on Droppy heads, bumps saveRevision and schedules a save; install() now recomputes hydraTokens from all turns' tokenSpends for Droppy heads; handle() gained two .tokenSpend cases (a simple append to the current turn at line 2172 and a routing case at line 2228 that sends agent spends to the native head's runtime or parks them in pendingNativeSpend until hydraAgentStarted drains them). (2) hydraWaiting tuples gained queuedAt: Date (Date.now at every enqueue) and spawnWaitingHeads writes it to the spawned head's queuedAt. (3) hydraDelegationRounds and hydraRefusedBlocks and static maxRefusedBlocks = 3 were replaced by hydraBudget = HydraDelegationBudget() (canDelegate, chargeRound, beginTurn(userAuthored:), refuse, noteDropped, takeDropNotice); startTurn prepends a pending drop notice to the prompt just before send; dropDelegationBlock now also queues HydraPrompts.interruptedBlockMessage(stopped: status == .interrupted) for the lead via hydraBudget.noteDropped (2783), but only on its no-heads-sent path ("Hydra sent no heads: ..."); the path where `stream.sent > 0` ("Hydra sent \(...) before the turn ...", 2760-2771) calls endDelegationStream, settleBatches and returns without queuing any notice for the lead. (4) New delegationParser: HydraDelegationStreamParser? and endDelegationStream(); scanStreamedDelegations gained text: and isDelta: parameters and feeds only the new delta to a persistent parser; flushDeltas passes each (id, delta) rather than a de-duplicated id list; the streamed guard became hydraStream != nil || hydraBudget.canDelegate. Behaviour change: in B1 scanStreamedDelegations read the text of `entryIndex[entryID]` itself; in B2 spawnDelegatedHeads calls `scanStreamedDelegations(entryID: hydraStream?.entryID ?? entry.id, turnID: turnID, text: message.text)` (2805) where `message` is from `entry` = the last assistant row holding a block (else the last assistant row, 2800-2801). When hydraStream claimed an earlier row and a later row holds a block, a fresh parser (isDelta false) reads the later row's text under the streamed row's ID and may queue its tasks as the streamed batch's remainder. (5) New hydraCurrentTurnTouchedPaths (private(set)) maintained by recordCurrentTurnEdits (guarded by `currentTurnID != nil, let root = workingRoot`, adds `TouchedPaths.relative($0.path, root: root)`, 3428-3431) from upsertTool, applyToolUpdate and settleCommand; noteHydraEdits (`hydraCurrentTurnTouchedPaths.formUnion(paths)`, 3439) and settleHydraCommand (`hydraCurrentTurnTouchedPaths.formUnion(writes)`, 3467) write it directly without the currentTurnID guard, so a native head's edits after the lead's turn ended still grow the set, and settleHydraCommand adds raw `git.changedPaths(from:to:)` output (`git diff --name-only -z`, repository-relative) rather than root-relative paths, which differ when the project is a subfolder of its repository; it is unioned in finishTurn, reset in startTurn, install (when no turn; when a turn is current install instead walks `entries where entry.turnID == currentTurnID` and calls recordCurrentTurnEdits(call.edits) for every tool row, comment "Native head events can arrive while their history is loading.", 625-630) and revert, and seeded in rehearseTurn; revert also now clears hydraTouched. (6) New isReadyForHydraMerge. (7) startTurn writes Droppy head timing fields (startedAt, queuedAt, executionStartedAt, executionFinishedAt, landingStartedAt, landingFinishedAt). (8) /compact is gated by thread?.provider.supportsCompact == true instead of the B1 list codex, copilot, deepseek, meta, zai, pi (supportsCompact in B2 also includes .claude). (9) ACPSession now also serves .opencodeGo.

Dead-code hazard in B2: handle(_:) contains case .tokenSpend(let spend) twice (lines 2172 and 2228). Swift matches the first, so live events only append the raw spend to the current turn's tokenSpends (no merge, no hydraTokens bump, no scheduleSave, nothing when no turn is current); the routing case with pendingNativeSpend and recordTokenSpend is unreachable from handle, which makes pendingNativeSpend always empty and the drain in hydraAgentStarted a no-op.

---

" from noteDropped in Hydra.swift 602-604 and 1086-1088, taken once), continuation.prompt + "

- path" for non-image attachments. antiSlopFallbackSent and continuationSent are set only if sessionEpoch is unchanged after send.

Hydra preamble selection when launch exists: if !launch.runsNatively, team = teamStatus(hydraTeam), canDelegate = hydraBudget.canDelegate; keepsHydraPolicyInSystemPrompt providers get fallbackTurnNote (user turn) or fallbackReportNote(canDelegate:); other CLIs get fallbackPreamble (user turn) or fallbackReportPreamble(canDelegate:); native launches with merge status get fallbackTurnNote(team: nil, merge:). merge = mergeStatus only when launch.autoMerges.
keepsHydraPolicyInSystemPrompt(provider) = AppModel.hydraIsNative(provider) || provider.isAPIKeyBased; only those sessions carry hydra: HydraLaunch in their SessionSignature.

SessionSignature per provider: launchRuntimeMode = runtimeMode for cursor, grok, devin, antigravity, else .auto only for copilot in Auto mode; launchEffort for claude and antigravity; launchFast for claude; launchModel and launchInteraction for antigravity; antiSlopEnabled from settings. A running session with an equal signature is reused; otherwise the session and native heads are stopped and a new one started.

ensureSession first runs `await app.providers.loadCatalog(app.hydraHeadsProvider(of: pair))` when `app.hydraIsOn(thread)` and the pair's heads provider differs from thread.provider (1439-1441), before the signature is built. ensureSession API branch: requires non-empty app.settings.apiKey(for:), else ProviderError.notInstalled; after start() it writes `app.updateThread(threadID) { $0.providerSessionID = sessionID }` at once (1526); passes transcript: apiTranscript() and isHydraHead: thread.hydra?.kind == .droppy; on a start failure with providerSessionID set, providerResumeAt nil, allowNewSession and not cancelled it restarts with resumeID nil. CLI branch restarts when startsOver(after:resuming:) (providerSessionID set and either lostConversation or no resume anchor), clearing providerResumeAt on a lost conversation and noting it if a turn is current.

lostConversation matches case-insensitively "no conversation found" or "no longer has this conversation". CLI branch only: recordSessionID (1603, 1610-1617; also used by `.sessionReady` events at 2121-2122) holds the ID in unsentSessionID when the thread has no providerSessionID, else writes it at once; startTurn writes unsentSessionID to the thread after a successful send (1372-1375). The API-key branch writes providerSessionID straight after start() (1526) and never uses unsentSessionID.
serviceTier: only codex, only when the model has a fastTier: fastMode ? tier : "default".

apiTranscript: excludes the current turn, user and non-empty assistant texts only, consecutive assistant fragments joined with "\n\n", keeps the last 40 messages, character budget 60_000 from the newest backwards; a message that does not fit is cut to "…" + suffix(budget) if budget > 200, else it and everything older are dropped.

Head budget: Droppy-run heads get HydraBudget.reportSeconds on a final report turn, else HydraBudget.maxSeconds + 90 for API-key providers (+0 otherwise); on expiry headBudgetSpent = !isFinalReport and interrupt(); at finish an interrupted Droppy head with headBudgetSpent starts a turn with HydraBudget.finalNote and headReportsNext = true (isFinalReport sent in TurnInput).

interrupt(): in .starting the turn ends at once as interrupted with currentTurnID cleared; otherwise session.interrupt() (or finishTurn if no session) plus an 8 s watchdog that releases the session and finishes as interrupted.

takeBackRunningTurn (Escape): only with an empty draft, no working heads and a non-Hydra user message; interrupts, polls up to 200 x 50 ms for idle, then revert(to:restoreFiles: false) and puts the message text and attachments back in the draft.

send(): local commands first ("/plan" toggles interactionMode plan/build; "/compact" only when supportsCompact), then dispatchSentHead when settings.hydraAlwaysHeads (never for "/plan" or "/compact"), else startTurn.

interruptAndSend(): with hydraAlwaysHeads a head takes the draft; with working heads the draft is queued instead of interrupting; otherwise pendingSend + interrupt, sent by drainPendingSend when the turn ends.

Follow-up queue: enqueueFollowUp trims text, drops empty prompts, dispatches to a head while running when settings.hydraQueueHeads || hydraAlwaysHeads and the pair has room, else appends and flushFollowUpsIfIdle (skipped when thread.lastStatus == .interrupted). drainFollowUps only after .completed, skips emptied prompts, handles local commands recursively and bumps autoStartedTurnToken. sendFollowUpNow sends a whole bundle, interrupting unless native heads work (then head or back to front of queue) or a pendingSend already exists (then front of queue).

Bundles: bundleFollowUp gives both the target's bundleID (or a new UUID) and moves the dragged prompt after the bundle's last member; moveFollowUp computes dest = to + (placeAfter ? 1 : 0), minus 1 when moving down, then unbundleIfSeparated; tidyBundles clears singleton bundles; bundleText joins plain texts with "\n\n" when no member has attachments, else the numbered format.

Delegation at turn end (spawnDelegatedHeads; it clears the stream with plain `hydraStream = nil` at 2809 and, when leftover tasks go out, sets it again `hydraStream = (turnID: turnID, entryID: stream.entryID, batchID: stream.batchID, sent: sent)` at 2824; it never calls endDelegationStream(), so delegationParser, and in that case hydraStream, outlive the finished turn until the next startTurn, dropDelegationBlock or install with no turn, contrary to the doc comment at 2975-2977 that names spawnDelegatedHeads as a caller): streamed block finalized first (marked sent, any remaining tasks queued if canDelegate, capped at 32 total, note for tasks not sent); unreadable block -> refuseBlock(unreadableBlockMessage(reason: nil)); empty block -> note "No heads went out: the lead did this itself."; budget spent -> refuseBlock(heldBackMessage(count:)); else chargeRound, mark sent, new batch, enqueue up to 32 with queuedAt, spawnWaitingHeads, holdSentDelegationBlock. Returns .headsOut unless no batch or waiting remains. refuseBlock starts a turn with hydraHeads: [] while hydraBudget.refuse allows (max 3 per request), else drops with a note and the notice rides on the next turn.

spawnWaitingHeads: posts "Hydra: \(note)" once per pair id; loops while launch?.hasRoom(running: runningDroppyHeads) ?? true; preferredIndex = delegation.name.flatMap(HydraRoster.index(named:)); passes project and profile; each iteration does `hydraWaiting.removeFirst()` before app.spawnDroppyHead, so a failed spawn (`else { continue }`, 3003) drops that delegated task for good with no note and no retry.

finishTurn order: cancel watchdog and head budget; claim finishingTurnID; settle command trees (lead and head); ignore stale completions; wait for settles (completed: all; otherwise race 3 s); clear currentTurnID; flush deltas; clear approvals/questions; close rows and fail running tools unless completed; store provider diff and anchor (and update providerResumeAt when one is set); parse provider patch off-main; end checkpoint; touchedPaths = reported edits inside root plus hydraTouched; union into hydraCurrentTurnTouchedPaths; diffRevision += 1; append .turnEnd summary; phase = .idle; saveNow; settleForegroundHeads; on an archived thread (`thread?.isArchived != true` guard, 2402-2406) it only sets headBudgetSpent = false, calls app.turnFinished(threadID, status: status, continues: false) and returns; otherwise pendingSend > delegation (only when status == .completed; on .headsOut it also calls `drainFollowUps(after: status)`, not on .turnStarted, 2419) > reports (status == .completed) > dropDelegationBlock (only when status != .completed) + drainFollowUps; reports flush unless interrupted; continues while Droppy heads run only when `status == .completed` (2435); head budget report turn; app.turnFinished; auto-merge when nothing continues, status completed, no reports/batches/waiting, hydraIsOn, settings.hydraAutoMerge and zero running heads.
isReadyForHydraMerge (new): phase idle, not loading, not reverting, no pendingSend, last turn .completed, no working heads, no pending reports, batches or waiting, and no report flush scheduled.

hydraHeadFinished: native head completes its tool row (.completed or .failed) then flushFollowUpsIfIdle; Droppy head builds HydraReport(headIndex, task, origin, status, text: summary ?? "", landing, copyPath, elapsed = Date.now.timeIntervalSince(info.startedAt) (2673); since B2 startTurn sets `$0.startedAt = .now` on every Droppy-head turn after the first (1217-1223), a report's elapsed covers only the head's latest turn (for example the HydraBudget.finalNote report turn), not its whole run; toolCalls), replaces any older report of the same index, files it in its batch or the pending list, then spawnWaitingHeads, dispatchQueuedFollowUps, settleBatches, flushHydraReports when idle and not interrupted, and flushFollowUpsIfIdle.

Report turn: reports sorted by headIndex, removed from pending, text = HydraPrompts.reportMessage(reports, stillWorking: app.workingHydraHeadNames(of:excluding:), reviewsHeads: settings.hydraReviewHeads), sent with hydraHeads = the head indexes.

hydraAgentEvent: an agent id matching a tool row of kind .agent is announced first; .turnStarted restarts a finished head; .turnCompleted(status, _) calls hydraAgentFinished(agentID, status: status, summary: nil); .toolStarted counts a tool, sets activity to ToolPresentation.label, notes edits and watches write-capable commands under key "\(agentID)-\(toolID)" then rehearses; .toolUpdated runs noteHydraEdits(update.edits) when present and settleHydraCommand("\(agentID)-\(toolID)") when update.status is set and not .running, then rehearses; .usage, .sessionReady, .models, .commands, .title, .assistantMessageID are ignored; everything else is rehearsed on the head runtime (rehearse(_:) is `handle(event)`, 3739-3741); .tokenSpend is not excluded, so a nested agent's spend reaches the head runtime's first `.tokenSpend` arm (2172-2176): a raw append to the head's current turn tokenSpends when it has one. hydraToolFinished maps .completed->.completed, .declined->.interrupted, other->.failed for foreground native heads.

Streaming pacing: first delta after a lull flushes at once if >= flushWindow (45 ms; heads use StreamLoad.headFlushWindow); otherwise delay 45 ms under 4_096 chars, 90 ms under 32_768, 150 ms beyond, at least 160 ms while scrolling; heads wait at least max(45, streamingCount * 70) ms; runtimes count as streaming for 2 s. Message/reasoning rows are only created on non-empty deltas; prose deltas pass through TextCleanup.withoutEmDashes, tool output does not. append() ends streaming on the last 6 entries.

Command edit attribution: only for commands where ShellCommandKind.mayWriteFiles(title) and the turn has a base checkpoint; the before-tree is settledTree (same epoch) else latestTree else the turn's baseCheckpoint; settle captures a tree, drops build output and paths other rows of the turn already report, diffs by name, splits the patch into one FileEdit per "diff --git " section, and leaves provider-reported edits alone. Edits with a diff over 200_000 UTF-8 bytes keep stats only.
noteToolMayWrite resets settledTree for any tool kind except .read, .search, .web and .command.

revert: requires idle and not reverting, the turn present and zero running Droppy heads; with restoreFiles it first requires removed.first?.baseCheckpoint (else "This turn has no file checkpoint. Choose to keep the file changes instead.") and runs `Git(directory).output(["rev-parse", "--verify", base])` (1851-1856) before any provider rewind, so a missing checkpoint throws with the conversation untouched; then provider rewinds per provider (codex rollback or error, copilot rollback, both through `ensureSession(directory:allowNewSession: false)` and then stopSession(), claude resume anchor or full reset at index 0, others new session); restores files only after the conversation rewind; removes entries and turns, clears hydraTouched and hydraCurrentTurnTouchedPaths, sets lastStatus to the last remaining turn's, usage = nil, diffSelection = nil, diffRevision += 1; returns false if file restore failed. resend (1820-1831): when revert returns false it sets `draft = edited`, overwriting whatever the composer held, and returns; only on the success path does it keep the prior draft, set draft = edited, send(), and restore `draft = kept`.

parsedDiff: filters edits to the checkout or any sidebar project path; touched = turns' touchedPaths normalized; git snapshot from the first base checkpoint to the last ended turn's end checkpoint; provider patches joined by "\n" unless providerFiles given; finished turns cached by turn (64), others by revision key uuidString or "all" (4).
recordHydraMerge keeps 20; markHydraMerged sets hydraMerged and saves immediately; hydraUnmergedFileCount counts distinct touched paths of non-running unmerged turns.

holdsOnlyPersistedState requires idle, no session, no revert, no pendingSend, loaded, empty draft, no edits, no approvals/questions, no reports/batches/waiting/native heads, no flush scheduled, no landing, not merging, no head budget, no command trees or settles.
appendStreamed swaps the enum payload out (self = .todos([])) before appending so the string stays uniquely referenced.

" keeping empties; a leading command is split off only if `first.hasPrefix("/"), lines.count > 2, lines[1].isEmpty, lines[2].hasPrefix(">")` (removes 2 lines); each run of ">" lines is one quote, each line dropping ">" then one optional leading space; one blank line is consumed only when `index + 1 < lines.count, lines[index].isEmpty, lines[index + 1].hasPrefix(">")`; with no quotes it returns `([], text)` whole; body = remaining lines joined by "
" with leading "
" stripped; with a command body = body.isEmpty ? command : command + " " + body.

startTurn guards (1177-1185): `phase != .idle || isReverting` calls enqueueFollowUp(text:attachments:) and returns (enqueueFollowUp hands it to a head via dispatchQueuedHead when `phase != .idle` and settings allow, 1000, else appends to followUps); a missing app, thread or project returns silently (1181); an archived thread (`initialThread.isArchived`) also goes to enqueueFollowUp.

handle(_:) arms not covered elsewhere: `.modeChanged(mode)` writes thread.interactionMode (2191-2192); `.title(title)` is used only when `turns.count <= 1`, `!thread.hasCustomTitle` and `app.textEngine(preferring: thread.provider) == nil`, written through TextCleanup.withoutEmDashes (2199-2203); `.exited` is ignored completely while `isStartingSession` is true (2217), leaving start() throwing to handle it, else releaseSession(stop: false), clears approvals and questions, stopNativeHeads, and with a current turn appends an .error notice `error ?? "\(name) stopped unexpectedly."` and finishes the turn as .failed (2218-2227); `.agentProgress(agentID, summary, lastTool, tokens, toolCalls)` sets the native head runtime's hydraActivity to summary when non-empty else lastTool, overwrites hydraTokens and hydraToolCalls when those values are non-nil (no addition), and stamps hydraLastEventAt = .now (2242-2247).

delegationParser holds one parser at a time (2947-2954): a delta for a different row (while no hydraStream has claimed a row; with one, other rows return at 2946) replaces it, and the next delta of the original row fails `existing.entryID == entryID` and starts a fresh parser that ingests only that delta, losing the row's earlier text mid-stream. Full-text re-reads with isDelta false in completeMessage (3221) and spawnDelegatedHeads (2805) build a fresh parser over the whole row, which is where such a block is read again.

sentPrompts (724-729) excludes user messages with isFromHydra (`hydraHeads != nil`) or isHydraBrief (`hydraBrief == true`, both in Core/Models/Timeline.swift 68-69); hasSentPrompts (731-736) excludes only isFromHydra, so a head's brief sent with hydraBrief: true (hydraHeads nil) is left out of sentPrompts but makes hasSentPrompts true. hydraAgentStarted gates `headRuntime.rehearseBrief(prompt)` on `!headRuntime.hasSentPrompts` (2550); rehearseBrief (3727-3736) needs turns.last with userItemID == nil and inserts a plain `UserMessage(text: text)` at index 0.

Row completion: completeMessage (3206-3224) and completeReasoning (3226-3242) remove the row (`remove(id)`) when the final text has no non-whitespace character; completeMessage runs a full-text scanStreamedDelegations (isDelta false) only for a kept row and only with a current turn. upsertTodos (3537-3545) updates an existing todos row of the current turn, and creates a new one only when steps is non-empty.

Plan approval: resolve() on a `.plan` request with a toolItemID pointing at a plan row sets `plan.state = option.role == .approve ? .accepted : .dismissed`, bumps saveRevision and calls scheduleSave() (debounced), then session?.resolveApproval (1721-1731). implementPlan (1141-1148) requires phase == .idle, sets plan.state = .accepted and saveRevision += 1 (no scheduleSave), sets interactionMode = .build, then `ensureLoaded(); startTurn(text: "Implement the plan.", attachments: [])`.
unresolved_questions: handle(_:) has two case .tokenSpend(let spend) arms (lines 2172 and 2228); only the first can match, so the B2 routing to native head runtimes, pendingNativeSpend and the merging recordTokenSpend path never run from live events. Does the shipped 1.6.2 binary behave per the first arm (append without merge, no save scheduled, no hydraTokens bump)? A parity port should decide whether to copy the observable behaviour or the evident intent; confirm against the compiled app.

HydraDelegationStreamParser is a final class defined in Core/Models/HydraDelegationStream.swift; its ingest semantics (delta vs whole text: spawnDelegatedHeads and completeMessage pass the whole row text with isDelta false, which builds a fresh parser) must be read in that file to confirm no double counting.
Exact values of HydraBudget.maxSeconds, HydraBudget.reportSeconds, HydraPrompts.maxDelegationRounds, delegationSentHold, delegationLeaveFade and Chrome.panelSlide live in other files.

startTurn sets head timing only when turns.count > 1 (the new turn is already appended), so a Droppy head's first turn keeps the startedAt/queuedAt set at spawn; confirm the spawn path sets executionStartedAt for that first turn.
